actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent, biologically interpretable identity supported by a strong RNA Hallmark program (EMT/DNA-repair up, heme and fatty-acid metabolism down, moderate-to-large SMDs with FDR significance) and a concordant CNV signal (CDKN2A/9p/9q/JAK2/PTEN loss, CDKN2A loss enriched at q<0.05). WXS is only nominal (PBRM1), but this is absence of FDR-level evidence rather than contradiction, and the direction is concordant with the CNV pattern. No measured technical factor is reported as dominating this molecular identity, membership is structurally compatible, and no positive Split or Merge evidence exists. Retaining C0001 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.

C0002 has a strong, coherent CNV-defined identity (many FDR-significant continuous features: lower chr12p/VHL/chr20q/BAP1/SETD2, depleted chr14q and chr8p loss) with moderate-to-large effect sizes, supported by a moderate RNA Hallmark signal and a single FDR-significant WXS feature (PBRM1 enrichment) concordant in direction. The identity is molecular and coherent, membership is structurally compatible, no dominant measured alternative explanation is reported, and no positive Split or Merge evidence exists. Retaining C0002 is better supported than Drop.

C0003 has a strong, coherent single-modality identity: marked FDR-significant depletion of PBRM1 and VHL mutations with large effect sizes and CIs excluding 1. RNA and CNV are non-significant but directionally suggestive (hypoxia/glycolysis down, chr1p loss up) and do not contradict the mutation-defined identity. A strong single-modality-defined subtype can be retained; membership is structurally compatible, no dominant measured alternative explanation is reported, and no positive Split or Merge evidence exists. Retaining C0003 is better supported than Drop.
